name: Jirina Kudro
description: The general of Drannith who leads the survivors along the terror road, deliberately leading them into Vadrok's nest as bait.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina leads Drannith's survivors along the terror road toward Lavabrink while Colonel Bryd urges sending soldiers ahead.
timeline.quote: Perhaps it would be wise to send a detachment of soldiers ahead, to prepare Lavabrink for our arrival.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Bryd questions trusting Vivien, and Jirina rejects his suspicion; then an attack on the column begins.
timeline.quote: I won't have you discarding one of our strongest on baseless paranoia!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian cats attack Jirina's Coppercoats and Jirina kills one with her sword.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A tigorilla and Haldan save Jirina from a second cat, and the tigorilla's crystals burn off Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexian oil bubbled and hissed, turning to a sickly black smoke

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina sees Vivien's green signals and knows the ambush failed and Lukka is still coming.
timeline.quote: That was the signal. They had failed. Lukka was still coming.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina deliberately changes the column's course to a path that does not lead to Lavabrink, silencing Haldan's warning about whose territory it is.
timeline.quote: If you want to make it to nightfall alive, you'll say nothing.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The refugees enter a basin of volcanic glass with no exit, realizing they are not at Lavabrink.
timeline.quote: there seemed to be no other road or pass out.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian Lukka climbs into the basin and announces in a thousand voices that Drannith's prodigal son has returned to offer Phyrexian unity.
timeline.quote: DRANNITH! TRAITOR-CITY! YOUR PRODIGAL SON HAS RETURNED FOR YOU.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina watches Vadrok toss Lukka's corpse aside and burn what remains of the titan.
timeline.quote: So passes the captain of the Specials

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien steps in front of the survivors to keep Vadrok from attacking them, and Vadrok flies away.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Haldan and the crowd accuse Jirina of using them as bait, and Jirina defends that she had no other way.
timeline.quote: In war, there are no certainties,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells the survivors to survive what is coming, as another Phyrexian branch descends behind the mountains.
timeline.quote: A branch, Vivien had called them

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

relations.note: Jirina trusts Vivien as one of her strongest allies
relations.quote: We have few enough allies as it is.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.
